senses.gloss:
प्रु PRU, Ⅰ. Ā. prava, spring up;
 cs. prāvaya, P. reach to (ac.). ud, spring out. 🞄vi, pp. -pruta, cast away.

प्रुष् PRUṢ, V. pruṣṇóti, pruṣṇuté, 🞄sprinkle;
 besprinkle: pp. pruṣitá, besprinkled, 🞄moistened. abhi, V. Ā. besprinkle. 🞄vi-pruṣya, Ⅳ. P. squirt out.

प्रुषाय pruṣā-ya, P. Ā. sprinkle;
 besprinkle. 🞄abhi, wet, moisten. ā, besprinkle.
प्रुष्वा prúṣ-vā (or ā́), f. rime, ice.
